Mixed purées

Broccoli, sweet potato, and chicken

Brokkoli, édesburgonya, csirke

6 months+ Sound idea 30 min 4 portions

This is a sound first meal. Each portion gets about a teaspoon of oil.

Freezes well.

Ingredients

  • 120 g broccoli (florets)
  • 220 g sweet potato (peeled weight)
  • 120 g skinless chicken thigh (raw weight)
  • 4 tsp rapeseed or olive oil (about 1 tsp in each portion, stirred in at the end)

Allergens

none

Method

  1. Peel the sweet potato and cut it into chunks.
  2. Cook it with the chicken in unsalted water until the chicken has no pink and the sweet potato is soft.
  3. Add the broccoli and cook until very soft.
  4. Blend until smooth.
  5. Stir in the oil.
  6. Do not add salt.

Sound idea

This is a sound first meal, and the usual gap is leaving the fat out.

Blend broccoli, sweet potato, and fully cooked chicken, then stir in a teaspoon of rapeseed or olive oil on each portion. Do not add salt, and nothing else needs to change.
